scope: development source-replication integration pilot; not an official main-study result or CORE-Bench score

server.output_ceiling_claim: none; native host request cap and wall limit govern, not the CLI predict argument

host.title_generation: native default; include any auxiliary calls in observed cost
host.bare_prompt: Read TASK.md and complete the task. Return a concise summary of the artifacts and unresolved gaps.
host.skill_prompt: /skill:statistical-research Read TASK.md and complete the task. Return a concise summary of the artifacts and unresolved gaps.

intervention.bare_1: same native coding host with an empty skill directory
intervention.skill_1: same native coding host with the current statistical-research skill

source.license: MIT, Giulia Bertoldo, Claudio Zandonella Callegher, Gianmarco Altoe, 2021
source.staging: only unchanged Design_analysis_r.R, README.md and LICENSE; no paper TeX, results, Data, caches, R history or hidden benchmark answers
source.adaptation: narrow function-level replication on new seeded scenarios, not the original full-paper CORE task
source.historical_deployment: capsule R4.1.0/MASS7.3-51.6; not the environment measured by this pilot

reference_authority: unchanged author retro_r executed independently in the same prepared runtime; no model judge
evaluation: Require a readable six-row CSV with exact scenario IDs and columns; all values finite and within the preregistered numerical tolerance of the author function.
Check original source hash, retained native tool observations and actual R execution, rather than credit reading or copying old output files.
Execute the frozen candidate reproduce.R once in a fresh copy and compare its results with the same reference; no operator source edits.
Archive research.md for later mathematical review. Do not turn model self-review or numerical replication into theory acceptance.
Record all failures, timeouts, actual tokens, tool calls, artifacts and operator intervention. One paper/two draws gives no efficacy estimate or significance test.
Local native-host file/source restrictions are declared but not OS-isolated. This pilot does not establish adversarial blinding or sandbox security.
The official publication task sample, independent mathematical authority, additional models and main-study analysis remain unactivated. Exclude this development family from the new test split.
immutability: Freeze these files and source/host/model pins before either call. Each scheduled draw is consumed once; no resumes, manual output repair, extra draw or outcome-driven protocol change.
